messages.subject: Project Quartz - draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor, Gregory,

Attached is the draft non-binding term sheet reflecting where we landed on the commercials: 4.5m upfront, 5.5m of milestones (2m at TRL-7 qualification, 3.5m at first production order), a 6.5% royalty stepping down to 4.0% above 80m cumulative net sales, and a 750k minimum annual royalty from year three. Liability cap is still open - we've put our opening position at 100% but I expect to push to 125%.

Happy to talk it through before it goes to Birchall Stone.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1212

Whitfield Carter LLP. Confidential and may be legally privileged.
